_comment: Pinned Chrome for Testing for the publish verify job. Set version (e.g. from Google's last-known-good-versions JSON); URLs derive as https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/<version>/<platform>/chrome-<platform>.zip. An empty sha256 makes a DRY RUN print 'CHROME_PIN <platform> <version> <sha256> <bytes>' and fail the step; copy the value here. A real publish refuses an empty sha256. Hosts: win64 (windows-2025) and mac-arm64 (xcode-27).
